duration.text: The Pharmacy at Nanjing University of Chinese Medicine is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3333 USD/per year ￥ 24000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. "Application Form for Foreign Students Studying at Nanjing University of Chinese Medicine" 2. Scanned copy of passport (valid for 6 months from the date of submitting the application). 3. Highest educational qualification and/or degree certificate, as well as scanned copies of academic transcripts: Applicants are required to submit scanned copies of their graduation certificates and/or degree certificates; if the applicant is currently enrolled in school, they must also provide a scanned copy of the certificate issued by their school confirming their enrollment status. 4. Copy of HSK certificate. 5. Electronic photo: Color 2-inch bareheaded ID photo. 6. Economic evidence. 7. Certificate of No Criminal Record. 8. Health examination certificate. 9. Study Plan in China (written in both Chinese and English, approximately 800 words).

requirements.text: 1. The applicant is a foreign citizen holding a foreign passport. He/She has excellent academic performance, good conduct, no criminal record and is in good health. 2. Possess an educational qualification equivalent to that of a senior high school graduate in China. 3. Applicants must achieve a score of over 180 in the new HSK Level 4 examination. 4. 12 of the Ministry of Education of China (2020), and provide relevant proof materials as per the school's admission requirements.
